title: WE BUILD - Membership Credential - SD-JWT VC payload
description: Schema for the SD-JWT VC payload of a Membership Credential as defined in the rb-ds-membership Rulebook (Chapter 3.2). This models the JSON claims set prior to SD-JWT disclosure/packing, aligned with the catalog baseline of HAIP draft-03 and SD-JWT VC draft -09.

identifier.description: An identifier together with the scheme it belongs to. See Rulebook Section 2.2.4 and code list 2.8.

type.description: Identifier scheme. Indicative, not a closed enumeration: platform-specific and member-state-specific schemes are permitted.

value.description: The identifier value, in the scheme given by type.

economicOperator.description: An economic operator, identified by its legal name and an identifier. See Rulebook Section 2.2.3.

legalName.description: Official legal name of the economic operator.

iss.description: Issuer identifier. For the SD-JWT VC profile this is normally the onboarding service provider HTTPS URL.

iat.description: Issued-at timestamp as a JWT NumericDate.

nbf.description: Not-before timestamp as a JWT NumericDate, where used.

exp.description: Expiration timestamp as a JWT NumericDate.

vct.description: Verifiable Credential Type for the Membership Credential.

attestation_legal_category.description: Legal category of the attestation. In EBWV v0.1, EAA denotes the non-qualified Electronic Attestation of Attributes category.

id.description: DID of the credential subject. May change, in contrast to member.identifier. DS-specific name retained for interoperability.

member.description: The holder of the credential, as an economic operator. member.identifier carries the stable, EU-level identifier; for the MVP this re-uses the EUID from the holder's EUBWOID. DS-specific name retained for interoperability.

memberOf.description: DSI or dataspace membership value. An absolute URI minted by the owning DSI/dataspace under its own domain.

role.description: Non-empty array of roles the holder has within the DSI or dataspace. Each value is an absolute URI under the https://w3id.org/ebwv/roles# namespace.

termsOfUse.description: Dataspace governance rulebook information. See Rulebook Section 2.2.1.

url.description: Reference to the online dataspace governance rulebook.

version.description: Version of the online rulebook at the time of acceptance.

hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the rulebook, represented as 64 hexadecimal characters.

acceptedAt.description: Datetime when the rulebook was accepted, where present. Subject to integrity rule IR-01.

onboardedBy.description: The platform through which the holder was onboarded: the platform itself, the economic operator hosting it, and the identifier by which that platform knows the holder. See Rulebook Section 2.2.2.

platformId.description: DID identifying the platform through which the holder was onboarded.

name.description: Commercial name of the platform (DSI or onboarding partner).

operator.description: The economic operator hosting and running the platform. Its identifier identifies that organisation, NOT the holder.

memberIdentifier.description: The identifier by which the platform knows THE HOLDER (the credential subject, not the platform operator). Bridges the EU-level identifier in member.identifier to a legacy or platform-local identifier of the same holder. Subject to integrity rules IR-03 and IR-04.

status_list_credential.description: URI of the Status List Credential that contains the status bitstring.

status_list_index.description: Zero-based index into the status list bitstring for this credential.

cnf.description: Confirmation claims per SD-JWT VC. Used when the credential is holder-bound.

jwk.description: Public key bound to the holder.
